Thanks — policy + compliance notes below: 

1) Sponsorship policy: Redwood will sponsor and pay government filing fees and our immigration counsel for initial petition. Candidate must provide required identity and work-authority docs within 10 calendar days of accepting the offer. Timing: typical service + government windows estimate 6–10 weeks; expedite available at added cost (we can confirm with VisaAssist).

2) Relocation: People Ops supports a one-time relocation allowance. We prefer a clawback (prorated over 12 months) for lump-sum relocation payments; agreed to absorb visa/legal costs (no clawback).

3) Approvals: Anything > $20k requires VP Finance approval. David: please route to VP (Karthik Iyer) if the final line total remains at $24k. If we reallocate to include shipping under $20k then People Ops can approve without VP (but given line items, likely > $20k).

4) Immigration vendor: VisaAssist is engaged for initial estimate. Please ask them to provide a statement of work and fixed-fee cap for legal services if possible. We must also collect candidate signed consent for sponsor filing (attachment: visa_quote_VisaAssist.pdf).

5) Offer language: HR needs explicit language that Redwood will cover sponsorship and filing fees; relocation reimbursement to be processed after receipts within 60 days of start. Draft clause below: 

"Redwood Inference will sponsor your employment-based visa petition and reimburse all associated filing and counsel fees. Redwood will provide a one-time relocation allowance as described; reimbursement will be made upon submission of receipts and is subject to a prorated repayment clause if employment terminates within 12 months."

If everyone confirms, I will prepare the final Offer Terms doc and HR clause for DocuSign.
